original_ai_output.title_zh: 加纳议员Baffour Awuah被正式指控洗钱及造成公共资金损失
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 加纳Manhyia South选区议员Nana Agyei Baffour Awuah的律师称，经济与有组织犯罪办公室（EOCO）已正式对其当事人提出指控，罪名包括洗钱和造成国家财政损失。该议员此前曾被EOCO搜查其律师事务所，并称愿意配合调查。目前消息为单一来源，指控尚未经法院证实。

key_facts.fact: 加纳议员Baffour Awuah被EOCO正式指控洗钱及造成国家财政损失
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Lawyer for Manhyia South Member of Parliament Nana Agyei Baffour Awuah says the Economic and Organised Crime Office (EOCO) has formally charged his client with offences including money laundering and causing financial loss to the state.

key_facts.fact: 该议员此前曾被EOCO搜查其律师事务所
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: EOCO search of Baffour Awuah’s law firm raises confidentiality concerns – Atta Akyea

key_facts.fact: 该议员表示若收到邀请绝不会忽视EOCO的传唤
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: “I will never ignore an invitation from EOCO if I had received one” — Manhyia MP

uncertainties: 指控信息来自该议员律师的单一来源，尚未获得独立交叉验证
相关指控尚未经法院审理证实
